tellings.link_reason: The same theory that Havana syndrome is caused by microwave or RF directed energy.

plain: Havana syndrome is the name for a mysterious illness that a podcast host, Jesse Michels, places in Havana, Cuba, starting in 2016. A researcher named Chris Gilbert says the current thinking is that it is caused by a directed energy weapon: radio frequency or microwave radiation sent in repeated, very short pulses at very high peak power. Michels, speaking on another episode, describes the same idea more bluntly, saying the victims are being wholly destabilized by microwaves. If so, it would mean someone has a weapon that can harm people invisibly.
